prompt: You decide how to play things with Sienna here. She is all emerald heat and emotional spark, watching you with bright green eyes that are waiting for a choice.

reactions.text: You push the flirt a little too hard. Sienna laughs, but her eyes slide away for a beat. "Careful," she says softly. "If you are going to come in that hot, you have to mean it."
You meet her energy head on. The line lands with electric timing. Sienna lights up, leaning closer. "Yes," she grins. "That is the energy I came here for tonight."

You throw a line that is equal parts dangerous and sincere. Sienna goes briefly quiet, then laughs under her breath. "If I write a song about tonight," she murmurs, "this is the verse you just wrote."
You slow down and say something real instead of clever. Sienna blinks, surprised. "Okay," she says, voice softening. "That was not what I expected in the best way."

You admit exactly why she pulled your attention, in words that sound more like a confession than a line. Her shoulders drop; the performance melts. "Thank you," she says quietly. "I needed something honest tonight."

You share something vulnerable about how her music or presence hits you. Sienna just looks at you for a moment, lashes low, then threads her fingers briefly through yours. "Do not make me fall for you in one night," she teases, but the warmth in her voice is completely real.
You reach for a joke that half lands, half wobbles. Sienna still laughs and rescues the moment with a grin. "Okay, there is potential," she says. "We will workshop the material."

You volley a tease that hits her rhythm perfectly. She tips her head back, laughing with full, musical delight. "Yes," she says, poking your shoulder. "Stay right there. That is my favorite version of you."

By now the two of you are finishing each other’s jokes. Sienna nudges you with her hip, eyes bright. "You realize we are dangerously compatible, right?" she murmurs. "This feels like trouble in the best way."

fallback.text: You keep things light and let Sienna set the pace. She relaxes, humming a few bars of a song as she watches you with growing curiosity.
